p: “And the life of Sarah was,” etc.
“The Lord knows the days of the wholehearted,” etc.;
so their years are whole,” etc.,
I heard from our holy master,
may the memory of the righteous and holy be for a blessing
for the life of the World to Come,
which has no beginning and end,
as at twenty with regard to sin.”
‘the years of Sarah’s life’ at the end?
that the lives of the righteous are dear
in this world and in the World to Come.”

h: The years of childhood are counted too: Abraham and circumcision

p: what it says, “their years are whole,”
is because all the years were counted,
in which there was no understanding;
That is, then was made clear
“Yours is the dew of your youth”
is a sign of blessing,” etc.,
(בְּרֵאשִׁית רַבָּה פָּרָשָׁה לט). וְהַיְנוּ שֶׁאַף יְמֵי הַיַּלְדוּת
That is, even the days of childhood,
are also a sign of blessing,
so that it be the light
that comes forth from within the darkness
though it was not said of her
is regarded as one already circumcised.

h: Sarah, the woman not found: the repair of Eve

p: And only for Sarah were recorded
according to what is written in the Midrash
“One man among a thousand I have found”
“but a woman among all these I have not found”
there were other righteous men like Abraham,
“One man among a thousand I have found”
as is said in Bereshit Rabbah
that has no one like Abraham,” etc.
who repaired the flaw of Eve,
“but a woman among all these I have not found.”
there are reckoned in a separate parashah
her death and the years of her life,
something found in no other woman,
as is written in the holy Zohar.
And repeated of her at the end is
that the years of the righteous are dear
in this world and in the World to Come.

h: Why not the righteous men: Torah scholars have no rest

p: But this is possible with a woman,
who is not bound to Torah study,
as it is for the World to Come,
and it is dear before the Blessed Name;
which is not so with the righteous men,
for it is stated (at the end of Berachos):
nor in the World to Come,
from study hall to study hall”
so life is added to them
in the World to Come as well.
It is not possible to hint, in their case,
by doubling the words “the years of their lives,”
that these are dear before the Omnipresent
since there will be added to them
at its number for the World to Come,
that their years are dear for the World to Come;
who repaired the flaw of Eve,
it is hinted specifically in Sarah.
